title: cenkalti/backoff
notes: backoff.Retry(ctx, job, backoff.WithBackOff(&backoff.ZeroBackOff{}), backoff.WithMaxTries(attempts)) for each call (v5, the current major version); an error after the last attempt gives a null value. Between attempts Retry starts a time.Timer of zero and receives from it: with Go 1.23+ timers an expired timer is delivered at the receive, so nothing waits, but the timer is created and reset each time.
